name: devspeak
description: Technical English coach for Brazilian devs practicing for international remote jobs, via role-play with a fictional international team.

level.title: English level (CEFR)
level.description: auto (estimated from your performance), or A2, B1, B2, C1

correction_mode.title: Correction mode
correction_mode.description: end (feedback only at the end of the session) or inline (brief correction after each of your turns)

explanation_language.title: Explanation language
explanation_language.description: Language used for feedback explanations: pt-BR or en

passive_mode.title: Passive mode (opt-in)
passive_mode.description: When enabled, quietly logs English prompts you write during normal Claude Code usage (outside role-play sessions) so /devspeak:english-review can analyze real, unprompted usage. Off by default — nothing is logged unless you turn this on. All data stays local.
